title: Stellar Astrophysics
description: A star's colour gives its surface temperature, and its brightness and temperature together give its size: a star radiates σT⁴ from every square metre. The Sun is the star close enough to use. Unlocks the Solar Furnace and deep-sky exposures.

puzzle.goal: A star is a ball of radius R whose surface glows at temperature T. Every square metre of a perfect radiator gives off σT⁴. Write the star's total power L.
puzzle.name: Stefan-Boltzmann law for a star
puzzle.ask: Find L for the Sun, in units of 10²⁶ W: R = @{R} m, T = @{T} K, s = 5.67e-8 W/(m²·K⁴).
puzzle.method: Multiply the power per square metre by the area of the sphere, 4πR².
